standard_prerequisites.name: A map of finite free modules whose cokernel is injective and free gives a locally closed condition described by the vanishing of minors

core_obligations: Let U be the open subscheme where the dimension function of the fibre cohomology in the bottom degree is at most r; any morphism satisfying the factorization condition lands in U, so the ambient scheme may be replaced by U (proof lines 8081-8088).
Show that the set where the dimension is strictly smaller than r is open, so that the required locus is closed inside U, at least set theoretically (proof lines 8089-8095).

At a point where the dimension equals r, use the local representation of the perfect complex by a bounded complex of finite free modules with the ranks prescribed by the fibre to get a concrete matrix description of the map whose cokernel computes the cohomology module (proof lines 8096-8112).

Cut out the locus by the ideal generated by the minors of that matrix in the appropriate size, which is a finite type quasi-coherent ideal, and check that the resulting closed subscheme represents the condition that the cohomology module be locally free of rank r (proof lines 8113-8125).

Verify the remaining assertions: the factorization property for morphisms into the base, the pullback description of the cohomology module for morphisms factoring through the locus, and the equivalent formulations in the case where the dimension function is globally bounded, including the injectivity criterion when the rank is one (proof lines 8126-8134).
proof_roadmap: Cut down to the open where the dimension function is bounded by the rank (proof lines 8081-8088).
See that the locus is set theoretically closed inside that open (proof lines 8089-8095).
Use the local model to define and analyse the ideal cutting out the locus (proof lines 8096-8125).
Check the factorization, pullback and special-case assertions (proof lines 8126-8134).
difficulty_reason: 54 行、构造性：先用维数函数的半连续与局部可构造把问题限制到「纤维维数 ≤ r」的开子概形，并看出「< r」是开条件（故待求轨迹在 U 内闭）；再在维数 = r 的点上用 perfect 复形的局部模型（有限自由、秩由纤维定）写出具体矩阵，用其合适尺寸的**子式为生成元**定义有限型理想并核对它切出的闭子概形正好表示「H^a 局部自由 rank r」；最后逐条验证分解性、拉回相容与维数全局有界时的等价叙述（含 r=1 时的单射判据）。承重步骤（限制、局部模型、子式理想）都在 span 内；5 处引用（3 同章、2 跨章）作导航桩。
